THMS.description: Multiple Support Excitation (THMS). A single ITEMS array holds one object per time history load case; each object binds a time history load case (LCNAME) to X/Y/Z ground-acceleration functions with per-direction scale factors and arrival times.

ITEMS.description: Array of multiple support excitation entries. Each object defines the ground acceleration input for one time history load case.

ID.description: Serial number of the excitation entry within the entity key. Used to identify/replace an existing entry; if omitted a serial is resolved from the load case name.

LCNAME.description: Time history load case name. Must reference an existing time history load case (THIS); a non-existent name is rejected.

FUNCX.description: X-direction ground acceleration function name. Must reference an existing time forcing function (THFC) whose data type is acceleration-compatible (nThisDataType 1 or 2); otherwise rejected. Leave empty to disable the X component.

SCALEX.description: X-direction scale factor applied to FUNCX.

FUNCY.description: Y-direction ground acceleration function name. Must reference an existing time forcing function (THFC) whose data type is acceleration-compatible (nThisDataType 1 or 2); otherwise rejected. Leave empty to disable the Y component.

SCALEY.description: Y-direction scale factor applied to FUNCY.

FUNCZ.description: Z-direction ground acceleration function name. Must reference an existing time forcing function (THFC) whose data type is acceleration-compatible (nThisDataType 1 or 2); otherwise rejected. Leave empty to disable the Z component.

SCALEZ.description: Z-direction scale factor applied to FUNCZ.
